thesis: Size every auction bid by the official liquidity of the issue it is buying - bidding less into auctions whose acceptance was thin or whose bid-to-cover was low - and hold the highest-scoring bill each week. The brief asked for bid sizing and liquidity to be part of the record; this participant makes it part of the rule, and the book prints the participation percentage of every award.
drivers: Best trade: 26-Week 912797QS9 (long, primary-auction to secondary-curve) 2025-10-21 to 2025-12-02 for $1,031.74.
15 of 15 closed trades made money; coupons paid $0.00 and financing cost $-11,484.76.

Official par curve over the window: 3-month 4.02% -> 4.14% (+12 bp), 2-year 3.52% -> 4.74% (+122 bp), 10-year 4.06% -> 5.01% (+95 bp), 30-year 4.66% -> 5.35% (+69 bp). Duration exposures are paid off against this path.
